None of them are explicitly labeled "audio," which explains why I was struggling to find the culprit. It appears my audio subsystem is integrated into the general `bridge-daemon.mjs` or one of the connection bridges. Since `bridge-daemon.mjs` (PID 43978) has been running for about 30 minutes and seems to be the active traffic handler, it's the most likely candidate for the blockage.

I will read the source of `bridge-daemon.mjs` to confirm if it handles the audio streaming component, so I can restart it cleanly instead of guessing.
